known_outcome: Regulator position (R2, May 2026): professional involvement is not required for a multiple-family dwelling of four or fewer units; for other buildings, drawings and specifications must be authenticated by the registered professionals qualified for the applicable disciplines; secondary suites need not be counted as dwelling units for Sentence (1).
review_focus: Separates the four-unit threshold from the five-unit rowhouse case
Asks which disciplines (building, plumbing, gas, electrical) the file must cover
Flags the authentication evidence the document requires
Uses R2 (current); the January 2025 and April 2025 versions are kept as superseded references
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
